entries.name: security-audit
entries.note: Security review skill. Its reference files describe attacks, which the scanner flags.

entries.name: interfaces
entries.note: 14 interface design skills under skills/. The repo is also a plugin, with no hooks or MCP servers.

entries.name: egm
entries.note: A plugin with 7 skills and no hooks or MCP servers, so its skills install on their own. Its 10 agent files under .claude-plugin/agents are not installed.

entries.name: astryx
entries.note: The one skill only, not the npm packages in the same repo.

entries.name: api-anything
entries.note: Starts an MCP server with `npx -y api-anything mcp`: no version pin, so each start can run new code from npm.

entries.name: bla
entries.note: Starts an MCP server with `npx -y bla-agents@3.4.1 mcp` (pinned to a version, not to a hash).

entries.name: ecc
entries.note: 27 hooks, an MCP server through npx, and hundreds of skills. Its hooks overlap what Almanac already does (memory, compaction, session start).

entries.name: ponytail
entries.note: Already installed on the owner's machine (version 5.3.3 is this commit).

entries.name: trufflehog
entries.note: Secret scanner, a Go program. Install a release from its GitHub page. Run it with --no-verification so found secrets are not sent to third parties to check them.

entries.name: skillspector
entries.note: The scanner Almanac uses. Install: uv tool install git+https://github.com/NVIDIA/skillspector.git@c81615007d40e86051a302a3cf897f8a05264928
